I. INTRODUCTION TO AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE TERMS Welcome, and thank you for choosing Live Hunt Share. This Terms of Service and User Agreement (“Agreement”), which also includes and incorporates our Privacy Policy, is a legally binding agreement between Live Hunt Share (“Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) and you (“you”, “user”) governing your use of the Live Hunt Share mobile application (the “App”), any associated client software (the “Software”), the https://www.livehuntshare.com website (the “Site”), and all related internet services and platforms (collectively, the “Services”) as a registered user (“Registered User”). Unless you accept this Agreement, you have no right or authorization to use any part of the Services that require you to be a Registered User. We may also offer additional products and services in connection with Live Hunt Share. Once you have registered as a user of Live Hunt Share, you may access these products and services with the same account credentials. Some additional products or services may have their own terms of service or user agreements, which you may need to accept before use. By checking the “I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and User Agreement” checkbox and completing the registration (sign‑up) process, or by continuing to use or access any of the Services as a Registered User, you agree and represent that: You are at least 18 years of age or the statutory age of majority in your country of nationality and residence, whichever is higher. You are not restricted from using the Services by law, contract, or by us. You fully agree with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement. Where required, your legal guardian has reviewed and consented to this Agreement and agreed to be responsible for any of your liabilities arising from its use. Your fundamental rights as a Registered User of the Services are set forth in this Agreement. We strongly encourage you to read all terms and conditions carefully. This Agreement includes a requirement to resolve disputes by binding arbitration on an individual basis. The venue for such arbitration may be outside your country of residence. Due to evolving technologies, changes in laws and regulations, and shifting market conditions, Live Hunt Share reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to modify or revise this Agreement at any time. To the extent permitted by applicable law, you agree to be bound by any such modifications or revisions. Any modified or revised version will become effective upon being posted to our Services (or at a later date if specified in that version). We may also provide notice to you through other reasonable means. Your continued use of the Services after such changes constitutes your acceptance of and consent to the updated Agreement. If you do not agree to any modification or revision, your sole remedy is to stop using the Services.

II. USER RIGHTS AND LICENSES 1. Rights to Access the Services A. Live Hunt Share provides an online and mobile platform offering comprehensive software and network services. These include audio and video live streaming, multi‑stream hosting, in‑stream games, private and public rooms, gifting systems, replay of recorded broadcasts, video‑on‑demand, music streaming, posting and social networking features, forums, messaging, and other interactive tools to connect and communicate with other users of the Services. B. Subject to your compliance with this Agreement, Live Hunt Share grants you a conditional, limited, revocable, non‑exclusive, non‑transferable, non‑sublicensable license to access and use the Services solely for your personal, non‑commercial use. You agree not to, and not to attempt to: i) Use the Services for any purpose not expressly permitted by this Agreement. ii) Attack, hack, disrupt, interfere with, reverse‑engineer, disassemble, or attempt to derive the source code of the Services. iii) Engage in any action that may infringe, harm, or jeopardize the lawful rights or interests of any person. iv) Copy, modify, adapt, create derivative works, distribute, license, sell, transfer, publicly display, perform, stream, broadcast, or otherwise exploit the Services or any part thereof, except as expressly permitted by this Agreement or authorized in writing by the Company. 2. License of the Software and the App A. The Live Hunt Share App and related Software are licensed, not sold, to you. They may contain copyrighted material and integrated or peripheral content. All rights not expressly granted under this Agreement remain with the Company. B. Subject to your compliance with this Agreement, the Company grants you a conditional, limited, revocable, non‑exclusive, non‑transferable, non‑sublicensable license to copy, install, use, and uninstall the App and Software on devices you own or control (including computers, smartphones, tablets, smart TVs, and wearable devices), solely for your personal, non‑commercial use. This Agreement also governs all updates, patches, and additional downloadable content provided by the Company. C. You may not rent, sell, transfer, redistribute, or sublicense the App or Software. If you sell or transfer your device to another party, you must first uninstall or log out of Live Hunt Share and remove all account‑related data. D. You agree not to exploit errors, bugs, or vulnerabilities in the App or Software, nor create, distribute, or use any programs, scripts, or tools intended to damage or interfere with the Services. 3. Use of Data You agree that Live Hunt Share may collect and use technical and related information — including details about your device, operating system, network connection, and installed software — for the purpose of delivering, maintaining, and improving the Services. This may also be used for customer service, technical support, and product development. Data will only be shared in a form that does not personally identify you, unless otherwise required by law or you have provided consent. 4. No Other Rights Granted Except for the rights and permissions expressly granted in this Agreement, no other licenses or rights are provided to you, whether by implication or otherwise.

III. USER ACCOUNT AND VERIFICATION 1. Your Account A. While some features of Live Hunt Share are available without registration, access to most advanced streaming, social, and monetization features requires you to create a Live Hunt Share Account (“Account”). B. When creating an Account, you may be prompted to provide certain personal details or log in with an existing account. You agree that all information you provide will be accurate, current, and complete, and that you will promptly update it if changes occur. You must not misrepresent your age or provide false details to bypass our access requirements. You will become a Registered User once your Account is successfully created. C. You may select a unique username and display name in accordance with our Platform Rules. We reserve the right to restrict certain names for legal, safety, or community protection purposes, including prevention of impersonation, harassment, or intellectual property infringement. D. You are solely responsible for keeping your login credentials — including your account ID, username, and password — secure. You agree to immediately notify us if you suspect unauthorized use of your Account. Live Hunt Share is not responsible for any loss or damage resulting from unauthorized access to your credentials. E. If you lose your password, you may request account recovery following our verification procedures. While we will make every effort to restore access, we cannot guarantee recovery in all cases, nor can we prevent fraudulent claims by imposters who provide matching information. F. All Live Hunt Share Accounts remain the property of the Company. You are granted the right to use your Account while it remains active. Your Account must only be used by you, and may not be sold, transferred, rented, loaned, or gifted to anyone else. If we detect unauthorized use or a dispute over account ownership, we reserve the right to suspend, reclaim, or terminate the account without prior notice. Any resulting loss of communication history, data, or virtual assets will be the sole responsibility of the user. G. We may suspend, terminate, or reclaim inactive accounts or accounts that violate our Terms, community guidelines, or legal requirements. Such action may be taken with or without notice and without liability to you. 2. Real‑Name Verification A. To access certain features (including but not limited to monetization, withdrawals, agency management, or hosting privileges), you may be required to complete a Real‑Name Verification process as mandated by applicable laws or platform regulations. This may include submitting personal identification details such as your full legal name, government‑issued ID or passport number, and a verified phone number. We will handle this information as described in our Privacy Policy. B. We may also use biometric verification methods — such as facial recognition, fingerprint scanning, or other technologies — to confirm your identity. You must personally complete the biometric verification process without substitution by another individual. C. By submitting your real‑name or biometric data, you confirm that all information is truthful, accurate, and your own. False or fraudulent submissions, or attempts to bypass verification with an imposter, may result in immediate account suspension, permanent termination, and potential legal consequences. You will be responsible for any loss, damage, or liability caused by providing false information.

IV. LAWFUL AND PROPER USAGE OF THE SERVICES When using Live Hunt Share, you must follow our Platform Rules, Codes of Conduct, and Community Guidelines (“Regulations”) to ensure a safe, respectful, and lawful environment. 1. Platform Rules We may publish specific rules for certain features or activities (e.g., streaming, chatrooms, games). These rules explain how to use the feature, what is allowed, and the consequences of violations. New rules or updates will be posted online, and your continued use means you accept them. 2. Codes of Conduct You must not use the Services to: Share illegal, obscene, pornographic, violent, or harmful content. Harass, threaten, impersonate, or defame others. Violate copyrights, trademarks, privacy rights, or other legal rights. Spread malware, phishing attempts, or harmful programs. Cheat, hack, or exploit bugs for unfair advantage. Share personal information of others without consent. Abuse customer support or make false reports. 3. Community Guidelines You are encouraged to: Be respectful and friendly. Create positive, high-quality content. Engage with the community in a constructive way. You must not: Do anything illegal or promote illegal activities. Share harmful content involving minors. Upload sexually explicit, violent, hateful, or self-harm content. Threaten or blackmail anyone. Spread malicious content like viruses or spyware. Steal or alter accounts or data. Organize harassment campaigns or spam others. Create deepfake or misleading content. 4. Consequences of Violations Breaking these rules may lead to: Removal of content. Loss of in-app currency or items. Account suspension or permanent ban. Restriction of certain features. Public notice of violation. Serious or repeated violations may result in stronger penalties, and you may be legally responsible for damages.
